title: DGM - Employee Relations
description:
JOB OVERVIEW:

To implement organization’s employee relations (ER) strategy to ensure a harmonious and productive workplace for all group of employees. This role is responsible for conducting HR / ER investigations, collaborating with key stakeholders for DAP (disciplinary action plan) compliance, coaching & capability building of business / line leaders on ER processes, fostering a culture of high engagement and ethical conduct, acting as a subject matter expert in matters related to labour and employment, new labour codes, maintaining 100% statutory compliance across manufacturing units and office locations across India & working with trade unions.

KEY STAKEHOLDERS:INTERNAL - Business / Division HR Leads, Plant HR Leads, HR Operation Lead, Legal Head, Function Heads.

KEY STAKEHOLDERS: EXTERNAL - External Legal Counsel & Advocates, Trade Unions, Industry Associations, Statutory Authorities, local authorities.

Reports to Head Employee Relations India PPL, Direct Reports - No

ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATION: MBA in Human Resources / MSW.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION – LLB / Certification in employee relations or HR investigations.

RELEVANT EXPERIENCE: 12–15 years in HR/ER, with at least 4–6 years in employee relations role within manufacturing environment.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

•Grievance / Discipline Management: Handle employee grievances, lead / coordinate HR related investigations, drafting of report, aligning the key stakeholders and helping line managers to close the disciplinary action plan.

•Policy Development: Design, implement & interpret ER strategies, systems, policies and procedures that support long-term business growth and strategic goals of PPL India.

•Standardization of employment documents: Collaborate and work very closely with HR operations to standardize the employment life cycle documents for all employees at factories / offices across India.

•ER Dashboard Management: Use ER metrics and dashboards to provide decision support to senior management regarding cases, compliance, and employee costs.

•Statutory Audits: Plan and conduct internal audits at manufacturing / non-manufacturing sites / offices across India for action planning and compliance.

•Subject Matter Expertise: Act as a subject matter expert on matter related to employee relations for BHR’s , HR operations and business leaders.

•Coaching & Capability Building: Build ER capability of BHR’s, business leaders and line manager on ER processes and new labor codes & compliances.

•Legal Coordination: Regularly review ongoing legal cases and proactively coordinate with legal counsel for matters related to labor office, PF, ESIC, labour welfare fund, inspections etc.

•Manage the central grievance reporting portal at PPL global level case management, reporting & insights action planning.

•Representing organization to external authorities like PF, ESIC, S&E, local police / administration, labour and employment authorities, courts and tribunals etc. KEY COMPETENCIES:

•Integrity & Ethical Leadership: Consistently behaving in a fair, transparent manner to build mutual trust with employees and external stakeholders.

•Resilience & Crisis Management: Remaining calm and decisive during difficult internal / external situations / union negotiations / union matters / inspections etc.

•Liaison & Relationship Building: Exceptional skills in building professional relationships with government officials, labor federations, and advocates / external legal counsels.

•Conflict Resolution & Mediation: Ability to handle internal / external conflicts in constructive manner in the best interest of the organization, able to navigate disagreements with trade unions or group of people for mutually beneficial outcomes.

•Strategic Thinking & Business Acumen: Understanding the broader healthcare marketplace and aligning ER strategies with the company's financial and growth goals.

•Effective communicator: Proficient in communication and should be able to present / explain / articulate ER/HR related matters to key stakeholders.

•Expertise in Labour legislations / Statutory Compliance: Should be able to understand, interpret, explain & resolve complex matters related to labour codes, shop and establishment act & case laws.

•Industrial Relations (IR) Strategy: Proven ability to manage collective bargaining and maintain cordial relations with internal/external trade unions to ensure zero production loss.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Piramal Pharma Solutions is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, ethnicity, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetics, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We base our employment decisions on merit considering qualifications, skills, performance, and achievements. We endeavor to ensure that all applicants and employees receive equal opportunity in personnel matters, including recruitment, selection, training, placement, promotion, demotion, compensation and benefits, transfers, terminations, and working conditions, including reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as well as individuals with needs related to their religious observance or practice.

title: Manager - Indirect Tax
description:
**Job Purpose:**
To manage and oversee all GST and indirect tax litigation matters of the organization, including handling show-cause notices, departmental audits, investigations, appeals, hearings, and coordination with legal counsels and consultants. The role is responsible for minimizing tax exposure, ensuring timely compliance with litigation requirements, and maintaining complete litigation records across locations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**GST Litigation Management**

* Independently handle GST litigation matters across India.
* Draft, review, and submit replies to Show Cause Notices (SCNs), notices, summons, and departmental communications.
* Prepare and file appeals before appellate authorities, tribunals, and other judicial forums.
* Analyze litigation risks and develop defense strategies in consultation with internal stakeholders and legal advisors.
* Track all ongoing GST disputes, investigations, assessments, and appeals.

**Representation and Hearings**

* Attend hearings before GST authorities and appellate forums.
* Coordinate with advocates, counsels, and consultants for litigation strategy and representation.
* Prepare briefs, supporting documents, factual summaries, and legal submissions for hearings.
* Ensure timely compliance related to Litigations with directions issued by authorities.

**Advisory and Technical Support**

* Research GST laws, notifications, circulars, advance rulings, and judicial pronouncements.
* Provide technical guidance to Tax Compliance Team, business and finance teams on GST implications and dispute resolution.
* Identify potential tax risks and recommend corrective actions.

**Coordination with Internal & External Stakeholders**

* Liaise with external tax consultants, law firms, and counsels.

Manage relationships with GST authorities and government departments.
  
  

* Manage & Co-ordinate with Tax Compliance Team within Organisation
* Coordinate with internal compliance departments for collection of information and documentation required for litigation matters.

**Litigation Tracking and MIS**

* Maintain a centralized litigation tracker covering all states and GST registrations.
* Monitor litigation timelines, hearing schedules, appeal deadlines, and compliance requirements.
* Prepare periodic MIS reports for senior management regarding litigation status, tax exposure, and key developments.

**Contingent Liability Management**

* Maintain complete documentation relating to tax disputes and contingent liabilities.
* Support statutory auditors, internal auditors, and management in assessing litigation provisions and contingent liability disclosures.
* Ensure proper documentation and record retention for all litigation matters.

**Audit and Investigation Support**

* Handle GST departmental audits, investigations, and assessments.
* Coordinate responses to audit observations and queries.
* Support closure of audit objections and disputes.

**Required Skills And Competencies**

* Strong practical knowledge of GST litigation and indirect tax laws.
* Expertise in drafting legal submissions, replies, and appeals.
* Experience handling departmental audits, investigations, and assessments.
* Ability to interpret legal provisions and judicial precedents.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and litigation tracking systems.
* Ability to manage multiple cases and deadlines simultaneously.

**Basic Qulaification:**

* Minimum 5–10 years of experience in indirect taxation with substantial exposure to GST litigation.
* Chartered Accountant (CA) with Strong knowledge of GST laws, rules, notifications, circulars, and judicial precedents
* Proven experience in handling SCNs, appeals, hearings, departmental audits, and assessments.
* Experience managing litigation matters across multiple states.
* Ability to work independently and interact with senior management, auditors, consultants, and government authorities.

**Skills**
Business Acumen, Critical Thinking, Digital Fluency, Enterprise Thinking, Influencing Without Authority, Problem Solving, Tax Management
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

 As a Security \& Compliance Consultant, you are responsible for helping the implementation of the organization’s information security and compliance programs. You will also help in implementing and reviewing data protection and privacy controls through technical, operational, and administrative measures. * Knowledge on Cyber Attack Vectors, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Attack Surface Mgmt., etc.
* Adequate knowledge on Incident Response, Business Resilience and Risk Management
* **Other responsibilities**
* To act as a Security \& Privacy champion/catalyst for all functions/BUs within the Company
* Training entire staff about security and privacy best practices whenever necessary



**Experience \& Other** 
**Requirements** 



* Degree/Diploma in Computer Science / Information Technology / Cybersecurity or equivalent
* **3\-6 years** 
 of experience in information security, with a focus on compliance
* Proven track record in implementing security and compliance policies \& controls
